notes:
# Quieter guard overnight {moon}
With the lid closed, Guard this Mac no longer sends a "paused" alert each
time the Mac briefly wakes itself. Closing and opening the lid still tell you.

# Update window stays in front {window}
The update window now opens above RecordLah's main window, so you can see it.

---

Everything else in this release:

- An alert sent late now shows when it happened, not when it was sent.
- Small fixes found by the full check run.
